countries.reasoning: Based on USGS and industry reports up to 2023, Russia is a leading producer of titanium carbide, mainly due to its advanced metallurgical industry; data is reasonably current and well documented.

China is a major producer of titanium carbide with strong output in refractory materials and chemicals, supported by recent Chinese government and industry data from 2022-2023; data is highly reliable.
The US has significant production of titanium carbide linked to specialty materials industries with data from industrial surveys and USGS 2023 estimates; moderately well documented.
Japan produces titanium carbide primarily for tooling and electronics; estimates come from national industrial reports with some data gaps making confidence moderate.
Germany has active production of titanium carbide in its chemical and materials sector; data is somewhat older but supported by European industry statistics.
